nodes.description: AT2-lineage cells can enter a stress-associated senescent state with reduced regenerative capacity and a secretory program that activates fibroblasts. DNA damage, telomere dysfunction, chronic Wnt signaling and metabolic stress are candidate upstream routes. Bleomycin-treated epithelial-fibroblast organoids show autocrine TGF-beta feedback and paracrine myofibroblast induction without immune cells. In vivo models establish senescence as a possible proximal driver, while the contribution of immune recruitment varies by model and cannot be declared universally necessary or dispensable.

evidence.reference_title: Autocrine TGF-β-positive feedback in profibrotic AT2-lineage cells plays a crucial role in non-inflammatory lung fibrogenesis.
evidence.snippet: bleomycin causes DNA damage and activates p53 signaling in AT2-lineage cells, leading to AT2-to-AT1 transition-like state with a senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Among SASP-related factors, TGF-β plays an exclusive role in promoting lung fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation. Moreover, the autocrine TGF-β-positive feedback loop in AT2-lineage cells is a critical cellular system in non-inflammatory lung fibrogenesis.

evidence.reference_title: Pathogenic Mechanisms Underlying Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: Recurrent alveolar epithelial cell (AEC) injury may occur in the context of predisposing factors (e.g., genetic, environmental, epigenetic, immunologic, and gerontologic), leading to metabolic dysfunction, senescence, aberrant epithelial cell activation, and dysregulated epithelial repair.

evidence.reference_title: Senescence of Alveolar Type 2 Cells Drives Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: We used conditional loss of Sin3a in adult mouse AT2 cells to initiate a program of p53-dependent cellular senescence, AT2 cell depletion, and spontaneous, progressive pulmonary fibrosis.

nodes.description: FAO gene expression is reduced in human IPF alveolar epithelium. Experimental CPT1a deficiency produces mitochondrial dysfunction, lower SMAD7 and increased TGF-beta signaling, abnormal epithelial intermediates and increased injury susceptibility. These findings support a metabolic contribution to abnormal repair without proving that FAO loss is the initiating event in human IPF.

evidence.reference_title: Regulation of lung progenitor plasticity and repair by fatty acid oxidation.
evidence.snippet: Genetic and pharmacological inhibition in AT2 cells of carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1a (CPT1a), the rate-limiting enzyme of FAO, promoted mitochondrial dysfunction and acquisition of aberrant intermediate states expressing basaloid, and airway secretory cell markers SCGB1A1 and SCGB3A2.

evidence.reference_title: Regulation of lung progenitor plasticity and repair by fatty acid oxidation.
evidence.snippet: Furthermore, mice with deficiency of CPT1a in AT2 cells show enhanced susceptibility to developing lung fibrosis with an accumulation of epithelial cells expressing markers of intermediate cells, airway secretory cells, and senescence.

nodes.description: AT2 cells normally regenerate the alveolar epithelium. Senescence and telomere dysfunction impair renewal and can deplete functional progenitors. Cell loss and a persistent senescent secretory state are distinct mechanisms: the Sin3a model distinguishes progressive senescence-associated fibrosis from transient remodeling after AT2 ablation.
nodes.id: AT2 progenitor exhaustion and impaired alveolar regeneration

evidence.reference_title: Short telomeres are a risk factor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: Short telomeres limit tissue renewal capacity in the lung and germ-line mutations in telomerase components, hTERT and hTR, underlie inheritance in a subset of families with IPF.

evidence.reference_title: Senescence of Alveolar Type 2 Cells Drives Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: We establish that senescence rather than loss of AT2 cells promotes progressive fibrosis and show that either genetic or pharmacologic interventions targeting p53 activation or senescence block fibrogenesis.

nodes.description: Induced p53-dependent AT2 senescence produces progressive fibrosis; comparison with conditional AT2 ablation distinguishes senescence from simple cell loss.

nodes.description: KRT5-negative/KRT17-positive aberrant basaloid epithelial cells coexpress basal, mesenchymal and senescence-related markers and occur near myofibroblast foci in fibrotic human lungs. Their transcriptome is a disease-associated state rather than proof of epithelial conversion into fibroblasts. Human AT2 cultures can undergo a basal transition under defined signaling conditions, but the origin and causal contribution of every basaloid cell population in human IPF remain unresolved.

evidence.snippet: Among epithelial cells enriched in IPF, we identify a previously unidentified population of aberrant basaloid cells that coexpress basal epithelial, mesenchymal, senescence, and developmental markers and are located at the edge of myofibroblast foci in the IPF lung.

evidence.reference_title: Chronic TGFβ1 Signaling Drives Aberrant Alveolar-Basaloid Metaplasia through a KRT17-Stratifin migratory complex.
evidence.snippet: Using integrated single nucleus ATAC- and RNA-sequencing on human lungs and an in vitro model of dysplastic repair, we identify two distinct regenerative trajectories for alveolar type 2 (AT2) cells: a resolvable euplastic repair trajectory and a persistent, non-resolving dysplastic repair trajectory. The latter is governed by a spatially restricted ITGB6/TGFβ1/SMAD3 signaling axis in fibrotic regions of IPF lungs and in murine lungs characterized by chronic epithelial remodeling.

nodes.description: Endothelial ERG dysregulation and capillary cell-state changes accompany aging and fibrotic repair. Human transcriptional overlap supports relevance but does not establish an independent initiating vascular lesion in all IPF.

evidence.snippet: Loss of endothelial ERG ... impairs lung fibrosis resolution in young mice in vivo.

nodes.description: Pathogenic telomere-maintenance variants and age-related shortening can produce dysfunctional telomeres and persistent DNA-damage signaling in alveolar epithelial cells. The human genetic evidence supports susceptibility, with incomplete penetrance. Experimental shelterin/TRF1 uncapping can induce spontaneous lung fibrosis, whereas AT2-specific TERT loss increases bleomycin susceptibility without measurable telomere shortening in one model. These perturbations must not be treated as interchangeable demonstrations of physiological telomere attrition.

evidence.reference_title: Occupational and environmental risk factors for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis in Australia: case-control study.
evidence.snippet: respirable dust (OR 1.38; 1.04 to 1.82) and asbestos (OR 1.57; 1.15 to 2.15) were independently associated with increased risk of IPF.

nodes.description: Pooled observational studies associate wood-dust exposure with IPF, but smoking-adjusted estimates in an earlier meta-analysis included the null. Hardwood, softwood and job-related coexposures are not interchangeable. This is an uncertain susceptibility association rather than a sufficient cause.

evidence.reference_title: The Impact of Occupational Exposures on the Risk of Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
evidence.snippet: ORs and PAFs, respectively, were found to be 1.6 and 7% for metal dust, 1.6 and 3% for wood dust, 1.8 and 14% for agricultural dust, and 1.8 and 4% for silica dust.

evidence.reference_title: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: What do we Know about the Role of Occupational and Environmental Determinants? A Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis.

evidence.reference_title: Exome sequencing links mutations in PARN and RTEL1 with familial pulmonary fibrosis and telomere shortening.
evidence.snippet: PARN and RTEL1 mutation carriers had shortened leukocyte telomere lengths, and we observed epigenetic inheritance of short telomeres in family members.

evidence.reference_title: An Exome Sequencing Study to Assess the Role of Rare Genetic Variation in Pulmonary Fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: A subanalysis of 186 case subjects with sporadic IPF confirmed TERT, RTEL1, and PARN as study-wide significant contributors to sporadic IPF.

nodes.description: Epithelial and mesenchymal TGF-beta signaling promotes myofibroblast differentiation and dysplastic epithelial repair. In a bleomycin-exposed organoid system an epithelial autocrine loop sustains a profibrotic secretory state. Sustained signaling also redirects human AT2 repair toward basaloid intermediates; this is distinct from epithelial conversion into fibroblasts.
nodes.id: Persistent epithelial and mesenchymal TGF-beta signaling

evidence.reference_title: Autocrine TGF-β-positive feedback in profibrotic AT2-lineage cells plays a crucial role in non-inflammatory lung fibrogenesis.
evidence.snippet: Among SASP-related factors, TGF-β plays an exclusive role in promoting lung fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation.

evidence.reference_title: Autocrine TGF-β-positive feedback in profibrotic AT2-lineage cells plays a crucial role in non-inflammatory lung fibrogenesis.
evidence.snippet: Moreover, the autocrine TGF-β-positive feedback loop in AT2-lineage cells is a critical cellular system in non-inflammatory lung fibrogenesis.

nodes.description: Oral antifibrotic therapy that slows clinical progression and FVC decline. It is not established to reverse existing scarring. Gastrointestinal and skin adverse effects and liver monitoring affect use.

evidence.reference_title: A phase 3 trial of pirfenidone in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: Pirfenidone, as compared with placebo, reduced disease progression, as reflected by lung function, exercise tolerance, and progression-free survival, in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

nodes.description: Recruited monocyte-derived macrophages can amplify fibrosis after epithelial injury through CCR2-dependent pathways. Macrophage behavior changes with cell state and disease phase: some macrophage-derived signals promote resolution and fibroblast apoptosis. Neither a uniformly profibrotic macrophage role nor universal immune dependence follows from these models.

evidence.reference_title: Diverse Injury Pathways Induce Alveolar Epithelial Cell CCL2/12, Which Promotes Lung Fibrosis.
evidence.snippet: In contrast, mice with lung epithelial cell-specific deletion of CCL12 were protected from bleomycin-induced fibrosis and had expression of CCL2 and CCL7 similar to that of control mice treated with bleomycin. Deletion of CCL12 within AECs led to decreased recruitment of exudate macrophages.

evidence.reference_title: Restoration of SIRT3 gene expression by airway delivery resolves age-associated persistent lung fibrosis in mice.
evidence.snippet: Together, these findings reveal a novel role of SIRT3 in pro-resolution macrophage functions that restore susceptibility to apoptosis in fibroblasts via a FoxO3a-dependent mechanism.

nodes.description: Pulmonary hypertension may complicate fibrotic lung disease and worsen functional limitation. It is not equivalent to primary pulmonary arterial hypertension.

evidence.snippet: Although many patients with IPF‐PH have only mild PH, some have severe PH, and their prognosis remains poor.

evidence.snippet: Apoptosis, senescence, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, endothelial-mesenchymal transition, and epithelial cell migration have been shown to play a key role in IPF-associated tissue remodeling.

evidence.snippet: These data are consistent with SFTPA2 germline mutations that interfere with protein trafficking and cause familial IPF and lung cancer.

nodes.description: Mitochondrial DNA accumulation in cytosol and extracellular medium accompanies stressed IPF epithelial cultures. cGAS inhibition, RNA interference and DNase experiments support self-DNA-dependent senescence amplification. The study does not demonstrate obligatory STING activation or a requirement for recruited immune cells in every fibrosis model.

evidence.reference_title: A cGAS-dependent response links DNA damage and senescence in alveolar epithelial cells: a potential drug target in IPF.
evidence.snippet: Furthermore, ectopic mtDNA augmented cGAS-dependent senescence of Ctrl-AECs, whereas DNAse I treatment diminished IPF-AEC senescence.

nodes.description: Aging-associated myofibroblasts can fail to dedifferentiate and become resistant to apoptosis. NOX4/NRF2 redox imbalance, sustained MyoD and BCL-2-dependent survival support persistence in experimental systems. Human IPF fibroblasts share aspects of these states. Senescence therefore contributes through mesenchymal persistence as well as epithelial dysfunction.
nodes.id: Senescent myofibroblast persistence and apoptosis resistance

evidence.reference_title: Conditional BCL-2 Expression in Fibroblasts Promotes Persistent Pulmonary Fibrosis which is Reversible by Therapeutic BCL-2 Inhibition.
evidence.snippet: Here, we show that prevention of PDGFRα+ fibroblast apoptosis by conditional BCL-2 expression leads to the emergence and persistence of senescent, pro-fibrotic fibroblasts along with enduring, pathologic fibrotic lung remodeling.

evidence.reference_title: Impaired Myofibroblast Dedifferentiation Contributes to Nonresolving Fibrosis in Aging.
evidence.snippet: We demonstrated that nonsenescent lung myofibroblasts maintained the capacity for dedifferentiation, whereas senescent/IPF myofibroblasts exhibited an impaired capacity for dedifferentiation.

evidence.reference_title: Reversal of persistent fibrosis in aging by targeting Nox4-Nrf2 redox imbalance.
evidence.snippet: Nox4 mediated senescence and apoptosis resistance in IPF fibroblasts.

nodes.description: Rare surfactant variants predispose a subset of familial interstitial lung disease, sometimes classified as IPF. Misprocessing and endoplasmic-reticulum stress can compromise AT2 function, but variants differ: SP-A1 R219W-driven TGF-beta secretion is UPR dependent, whereas SP-C I73T and M71V secretion is largely UPR independent. L188Q SFTPC-induced ER stress increases bleomycin susceptibility without spontaneous fibrosis in one mouse model. Herpesvirus colocalization with UPR markers in human tissue does not establish viral causation.
nodes.id: Surfactant dysfunction and epithelial proteostasis stress

evidence.reference_title: Lung fibrosis-associated surfactant protein A1 and C variants induce latent transforming growth factor β1 secretion in lung epithelial cells.
evidence.snippet: We show that expression of two SP-A1 (R219W and R242*) and three SP-C (I73T, M71V, and L188Q) variant proteins lead to the secretion of the profibrotic latent transforming growth factor (TGF)-β1 in lung epithelial cell lines.

evidence.reference_title: Endoplasmic reticulum stress enhances fibrotic remodeling in the lungs.

evidence.snippet: ER stress and UPR activation are found in the alveolar epithelium in patients with IPF and could contribute to disease progression.

nodes.description: Current and former smoking are associated with IPF susceptibility in independent cohorts, with dose-response evidence. A Korean claims cohort identified 25,113 incident cases among 23,242,836 participants; smoking intensity, duration and diagnostic ascertainment affect estimates. Susceptibility is not equivalent to an identified cause in every patient.

evidence.reference_title: Impact of smoking on the development of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: results from a nationwide population-based cohort study.
evidence.snippet: The risk of IPF was significantly higher in current and former smokers than in never smokers, with an aHR of 1.66 (95% CI 1.61 to 1.72) and 1.42 (95% CI 1.37 to 1.48), respectively.
